sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: read about interesting classes at school;
sentences.meaning: 阅读关于学校有趣课程的内容；

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: get to know about school field trips and school chores;
sentences.ipa: /get tə nˈəʊ əbˈaʊt skˈuːl fˈiːld trˈɪps ænd skˈuːl tʃˈɔːz;/
sentences.meaning: 了解学校的实地考察活动和校园劳动；

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: talk and write about our life at school;
sentences.ipa: /tˈɔːk ænd rˈaɪt əbˈaʊt ˌaʊə lˈaɪf æt skˈuːl;/
sentences.meaning: 谈论并写一写我们的校园生活；

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: learn to enjoy our school life.
sentences.meaning: 学会享受我们的学校生活。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: There are many interesting classes and activities in middle school.
sentences.ipa: /ðˌeə ɑː mˈeniː ˈɪntrɪstɪŋ klˈɑːsɪz ænd æktˈɪvɪtiːz ɪn mˈɪdəl skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 中学里有许多有趣的课程和活动。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Let’s learn how to talk about our school life.
sentences.ipa: /lˈets lˈɜːn hˌaʊ tə tˈɔːk əbˈaʊt ˌaʊə skˈuːl lˈaɪf./
sentences.meaning: 让我们学习如何谈论我们的学校生活。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete the table on the right with your own daily activities.
sentences.ipa: /kəmplˈiːt ðə tˈeɪbəl ˌɒn ðə rˈaɪt wɪð jɔː ˈəʊn dˈeɪliː æktˈɪvɪtiːz./
sentences.meaning: 在右侧填写表格时，您要进行日常活动。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Look at the table of Millie's day.
sentences.ipa: /ə lˈʊk æt ðə tˈeɪbəl ɒv mˈɪliːz dˈeɪ./
sentences.meaning: 瞧瞧米莉的日子的桌子

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Work in pairs and talk about your school days.
sentences.ipa: /wˈɜːk ɪn pˈeəz ænd tˈɔːk əbˈaʊt jɔː skˈuːl dˈeɪz./
sentences.meaning: 成对地工作 谈谈你的上学日

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Millie and Simon are talking about their school days.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː mˈɪliː ænd saɪmən ɑː tˈɔːkɪŋ əbˈaʊt ðeə skˈuːl dˈeɪz./
sentences.meaning: B米莉和西蒙在谈论他们的上学日。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use the conversation below as a model.
sentences.ipa: /jˈuːz ðə kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃən bɪlˈəʊ æz ə mˈɒdəl./

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: What time do you get up in the morning on weekdays, Simon?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɒt tˈaɪm dˈuː juː get ˌʌp ɪn ðə mˈɔːnɪŋ ˌɒn wˈiːkdeɪz, saɪmən?/
sentences.meaning: 星期天早上几点起床，西蒙？

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: I usually get up at 6:45 a.m. and then go for a short jog. And you?
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ jˈuːʒʊəliː get ˌʌp æt sˈɪks fˈɔːtiː fˈaɪv ˌeɪˈem ænd ðˈen gˌəʊ fɔː ə ʃˈɔːt dʒˈɒg. ˌænd juː?/
sentences.meaning: 我通常早上6点45分起床然后跑个短跑你呢？

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: I get up at 7. I always read a little.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ get ˌʌp æt sˈevən. ˌaɪ ˈɔːlweɪz rˈed ə lˈɪtəl./
sentences.meaning: 我7点起床，我经常读一点

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: What do you like best about your school days?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɒt dˈuː juː lˈaɪk bˈest əbˈaʊt jɔː skˈuːl dˈeɪz?/
sentences.meaning: 你最喜欢的是什么关于你的学习日？

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: I like the after-school activities. I go to the Book Club and the Volleyball Club and have lots of fun. What about you?
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ lˈaɪk ðiː ˌɑːftəskˈuːl æktˈɪvɪtiːz. ˌaɪ gˌəʊ tə ðə bˈʊk klˈʌb ænd ðə vˈɒlɪbɔːl klˈʌb ænd hæv lˈɒts ɒv fˈʌn. wˌɒt əbˈaʊt juː?/
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢放学后的活动，我去了读书俱乐部和排球俱乐部，玩得很开心，你呢？

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: I’m in the Football Club. Club activities are a good way for me to enjoy myself and make friends.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪm ɪn ðə fˈʊtbɔːl klˈʌb. klˈʌb æktˈɪvɪtiːz ɑː ə gˈʊd wˈeɪ fɔː mˌiː tʊ ɪndʒˈɔɪ maɪsˈelf ænd mˌeɪk frˈendz./
sentences.meaning: 我在足球俱乐部里，俱乐部的活动是让我享受和交朋友的好方法。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C What do you like best about your school days?
sentences.ipa: /sˈiː wˌɒt dˈuː juː lˈaɪk bˈest əbˈaʊt jɔː skˈuːl dˈeɪz?/
sentences.meaning: C，你最喜欢什么关于你的学习日？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Millie wrote an email to her online friend Tommy.
sentences.ipa: /mˈɪliː rˈəʊt ən ˈiːmeɪl tə hɜː ɒnlˈaɪn frˈend tˈɒmiː./
sentences.meaning: 米莉给网友汤米写了一封邮件。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before reading, think about the questions below.
sentences.ipa: /bɪfˈɔː rˈiːdɪŋ, θˈɪŋk əbˈaʊt ðə kwˈestʃənz bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 在阅读前，考虑下面的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 What are some interesting classes at your school?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn wˌɒt ɑː sˌʌm ˈɪntrɪstɪŋ klˈɑːsɪz æt jɔː skˈuːl?/
sentences.meaning: 你学校有什么有趣的课？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 What activities do you often do after school?
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː wˌɒt æktˈɪvɪtiːz dˈuː juː ˈɒfən dˈuː ˈɑːftə skˈuːl?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Usually we fill keywords in the subject line of an email to let others know what we are talking about in the email.
sentences.ipa: /jˈuːʒʊəliː wiː fˈɪl kˈiːwɜːdz ɪn ðə sˈʌbdʒekt lˈaɪn ɒv ən ˈiːmeɪl tə lˈet ˈʌðəz nˈəʊ wˌɒt wiː ɑː tˈɔːkɪŋ əbˈaʊt ɪn ðiː ˈiːmeɪl./
sentences.meaning: 通常我们会在电子邮件的主题栏中填入关键词，让其他人知道我们在电子邮件中讲的是什么。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: This is my first term at Sunshine Middle School.
sentences.ipa: /ðˌɪs ɪz maɪ fˈɜːst tˈɜːm æt sˈʌnʃaɪn mˈɪdəl skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 这是我在阳光中学的第一个学期。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: School starts at 8 in the morning.
sentences.ipa: /skˈuːl stˈɑːts æt ˈeɪt ɪn ðə mˈɔːnɪŋ./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Usually, we do morning exercises first.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.ipa: /ðˈen ˌaʊə lˈesənz bɪgˈɪn æt ˈeɪt fˌɪftˈiːn./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We read the works of many famous writers.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː rˈed ðə wˈɜːks ɒv mˈeniː fˈeɪməs rˈaɪtəz./
sentences.meaning: 我们读了许多著名作家的作品。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The Chinese language is really amazing.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We have Biology classes on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː hæv baɪˈɒlədʒiː klˈɑːsɪz ˌɒn tjˈuːzdeɪz ænd θˈɜːzdeɪz./
sentences.meaning: 周二和周四都有生物学课

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We study many living things and learn about nature.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː stˈʌdiː mˈeniː lˈɪvɪŋ θˈɪŋz ænd lˈɜːn əbˈaʊt nˈeɪtʃə./
sentences.meaning: 我们研究许多生物，学习自然。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: After-school activities are great fun too!

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I am in the school volleyball team, and we practise on Friday afternoons.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ əm ɪn ðə skˈuːl vˈɒlɪbɔːl tˈiːm, ænd wiː prˈæktɪs ˌɒn frˈaɪdeɪ ˌɑːftənˈuːnz./
sentences.meaning: 我是学校排球队的我们周五下午练习

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We have a field trip each term.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː hæv ə fˈiːld trˈɪp ˈiːtʃ tˈɜːm./
sentences.meaning: 我们每个学期都有一次实地考察。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Tomorrow morning we will leave for a farm to pick apples there.
sentences.ipa: /tʊmˈɒrəʊ mˈɔːnɪŋ wiː wɪl lˈiːv fɔː ə fˈɑːm tə pˈɪk ˈæpəlz ðˈeə./
sentences.meaning: 明天早上我们要去一个农场 在那里摘苹果

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: What is your school life like?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Hope to hear from you soon.
sentences.meaning: 希望能很快收到你的消息。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Complete the chart below with the information in Millie’s email.
sentences.ipa: /ə kəmplˈiːt ðə tʃˈɑːt bɪlˈəʊ wɪð ðiː ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən ɪn mˈɪliːz ˈiːmeɪl./
sentences.meaning: Millie的电子邮件中的信息可填上下图。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Write a T if a sentence is true or an F if it is false.
sentences.ipa: /rˈaɪt ə tˈiː ɪf ə sˈentəns ɪz trˈuː ɔː ən ˈef ɪf ɪt ɪz fˈɔːls./
sentences.meaning: 如果句子是真的，写个T，如果句子是假的，写一个F。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Millie should get to school before 8:15.
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn mˈɪliː ʃˌʊd get tə skˈuːl bɪfˈɔː ˈeɪt fˌɪftˈiːn./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 The students read many great works in Chinese classes.
sentences.ipa: /θrˈiː ðə stjˈuːdnts rˈed mˈeniː grˈeɪt wˈɜːks ɪn tʃˌaɪnˈiːz klˈɑːsɪz./
sentences.meaning: 3，学生们阅读了许多中文班的优秀作品。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 The students have a Biology lesson once a week.
sentences.ipa: /fˈɔː ðə stjˈuːdnts hæv ə baɪˈɒlədʒiː lˈesən wˈʌns ə wˈiːk./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 The students are going on a field trip to a park.
sentences.ipa: /fˈaɪv ðə stjˈuːdnts ɑː gˈəʊɪŋ ˌɒn ə fˈiːld trˈɪp tə ə pˈɑːk./
sentences.meaning: 5，学生们要到一个公园进行实地考察。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 6 Millie enjoys life at her new school.
sentences.ipa: /sˈɪks mˈɪliː ɪndʒˈɔɪz lˈaɪf æt hɜː njˈuː skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 6米莉在她的新学校享受生活。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete his email with the correct forms of the words and phrase in the box below.
sentences.ipa: /kəmplˈiːt hɪz ˈiːmeɪl wɪð ðə kərˈekt fˈɔːmz ɒv ðə wˈɜːdz ænd frˈeɪz ɪn ðə bˈɒks bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 将他的电子邮件填写在下面的框中正确的单词和短语形式。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C Tommy is writing an email back to Millie.
sentences.ipa: /sˈiː tˈɒmiː ɪz rˈaɪtɪŋ ən ˈiːmeɪl bˈæk tə mˈɪliː./
sentences.meaning: C汤米正在给米莉写一封邮件

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I would like to tell you about my school life.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ wʊd lˈaɪk tə tˈel juː əbˈaʊt maɪ skˈuːl lˈaɪf./
sentences.meaning: 我想告诉你我的学校生活

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: 你的新学校听起来不错

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: In our English class, we read lots of famous books.
sentences.ipa: /ɪn ˌaʊə ˈɪŋglɪʃ klˈɑːs, wiː rˈed lˈɒts ɒv fˈeɪməs bˈʊks./
sentences.meaning: 在我们的英语课上，我们读了很多著名的书籍。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I can speak a little Chinese now!
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ kæn spˈiːk ə lˈɪtəl tʃˌaɪnˈiːz nˈaʊ!/
sentences.meaning: 我现在能说一点中国语了！

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We get to know so much about the world around us.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː get tə nˈəʊ sˌəʊ mˈʌtʃ əbˈaʊt ðə wˈɜːld ərˈaʊnd ˌʌs./
sentences.meaning: 我们非常了解周围的世界。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It is interesting to visit fun places.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɪt ɪz ˈɪntrɪstɪŋ tə vˈɪzɪt fˈʌn plˈeɪsɪz./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D Think about the questions below.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Share your answers with your classmates.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 What do you think about Millie’s school life?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn wˌɒt dˈuː juː θˈɪŋk əbˈaʊt mˈɪliːz skˈuːl lˈaɪf?/
sentences.meaning: 你对米莉的学校生活有何看法？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 What lessons do you like best?
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː wˌɒt lˈesənz dˈuː juː lˈaɪk bˈest?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 What do you think is special about your school life?
sentences.ipa: /θrˈiː wˌɒt dˈuː juː θˈɪŋk ɪz spˈeʃl əbˈaʊt jɔː skˈuːl lˈaɪf?/
sentences.meaning: 三，你对学校生活有什么特别？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We use different prepositions to talk about time.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː jˈuːz dˈɪfərənt prˌepəzˈɪʃənz tə tˈɔːk əbˈaʊt tˈaɪm./
sentences.meaning: 我们用不同的预设来谈论时间。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We read English in the morning.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Our new term starts in September.
sentences.meaning: 我们的新任期从9月开始。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We have a field trip in autumn.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː hæv ə fˈiːld trˈɪp ɪn ˈɔːtəm./
sentences.meaning: 我们秋天有一次实地考察

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We took a trip to a farm in 2022.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː tˈʊk ə trˈɪp tə ə fˈɑːm ɪn twˈentiː twˈentiː tˈuː./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We don’t go to school on Saturday.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː dˈəʊnt gˌəʊ tə skˈuːl ˌɒn sˈætədeɪ./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Our summer holiday starts on 1 July.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaʊə sˈʌmə hˈɒlɪdeɪ stˈɑːts ˌɒn wˈʌn dʒʊlˈaɪ./
sentences.meaning: 我们的暑假从7月1日开始。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We have a Biology class on Tuesday morning.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː hæv ə baɪˈɒlədʒiː klˈɑːs ˌɒn tjˈuːzdeɪ mˈɔːnɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 周二早上我们有个生物学课

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We have lots of fun on Children’s Day.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː hæv lˈɒts ɒv fˈʌn ˌɒn tʃˈɪldrənz dˈeɪ./
sentences.meaning: 我们儿童节有很多乐趣。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Millie often gets up at 7 o’clock.
sentences.ipa: /mˈɪliː ˈɒfən gets ˌʌp æt sˈevən əklˈɒk./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Children in China usually start school at 6 years old.
sentences.ipa: /tʃˈɪldrən ɪn tʃˈaɪnə jˈuːʒʊəliː stˈɑːt skˈuːl æt sˈɪks jˈɪəz ˈəʊld./
sentences.meaning: 中国儿童通常6岁开始上学。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete their conversation with the correct prepositions of time.
sentences.ipa: /kəmplˈiːt ðeə kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃən wɪð ðə kərˈekt prˌepəzˈɪʃənz ɒv tˈaɪm./
sentences.meaning: 完成他们与时间的正确预设的对话。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A1 Sandy is talking to her grandma about her school life.
sentences.ipa: /ˈeɪ wˈʌn sˈændiː ɪz tˈɔːkɪŋ tə hɜː grˈændmɑː əbˈaʊt hɜː skˈuːl lˈaɪf./
sentences.meaning: A1桑迪正和奶奶谈她的学校生活

sentences.speaker: grandma
sentences.text: Hi, Sandy. Tell me about your life at school.
sentences.ipa: /hˈaɪ, sˈændiː. tˈel mˌiː əbˈaʊt jɔː lˈaɪf æt skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 嗨，桑迪，告诉我你在学校的生活

sentences.speaker: grandma
sentences.text: Good. Do you play any sport at school?
sentences.ipa: /gˈʊd. dˈuː juː plˈeɪ ˈeniː spˈɔːt æt skˈuːl?/
sentences.meaning: 很好，你在学校玩过运动吗？

sentences.speaker: grandma
sentences.text: That’s exciting! When is this year’s match?
sentences.ipa: /ðˈæts ɪksˈaɪtɪŋ! wˌen ɪz ðɪs jˈɪəz mˈætʃ?/
sentences.meaning: 这令人兴奋！今年的比赛是什么时候？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Would you like to come and watch?
sentences.ipa: /wˌʊd juː lˈaɪk tə kˈʌm ænd wˈɒtʃ?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A2 Talk with your partner about your school life, using prepositions of time.
sentences.ipa: /ˈeɪ tˈuː tˈɔːk wɪð jɔː pˈɑːtnə əbˈaʊt jɔː skˈuːl lˈaɪf, jˈuːzɪŋ prˌepəzˈɪʃənz ɒv tˈaɪm./
sentences.meaning: A2 与你的搭档谈谈你的学校生活， 利用时间的预设。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Adverbs of frequency tell you how often things happen.
sentences.ipa: /ˈædvɜːbz ɒv frˈiːkwənsiː tˈel juː hˌaʊ ˈɒfən θˈɪŋz hˈæpən./
sentences.meaning: 频率的副词告诉你事情的发生频率。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B1 Sandy is writing about how often she and her classmates exercise.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː wˈʌn sˈændiː ɪz rˈaɪtɪŋ əbˈaʊt hˌaʊ ˈɒfən ʃiː ænd hɜː klˈɑːsmeɪts ˈeksəsaɪz./
sentences.meaning: B1 桑迪在写她和同学的锻炼频率。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then help her complete the notes below.
sentences.ipa: /ðˈen hˈelp hɜː kəmplˈiːt ðə nˈəʊts bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 那就帮她完成下面的笔记

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We put an adverb of frequency after the verb be.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː pˌʊt ən ˈædvɜːb ɒv frˈiːkwənsiː ˈɑːftə ðə vˈɜːb bˈiː./
sentences.meaning: 我们在动词后加了一个频率副词。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I do not have much time to play tennis.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ dˈuː nˌɒt hæv mˈʌtʃ tˈaɪm tə plˈeɪ tˈenɪs./
sentences.meaning: 我没有太多时间打网球。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Amy is a member of the swimming team.
sentences.ipa: /ˈeɪmiː ɪz ə mˈembə ɒv ðə swˈɪmɪŋ tˈiːm./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B2 Write six sentences about your school activities, using each adverb of frequency above once.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː tˈuː rˈaɪt sˈɪks sˈentənsɪz əbˈaʊt jɔː skˈuːl æktˈɪvɪtiːz, jˈuːzɪŋ ˈiːtʃ ˈædvɜːb ɒv frˈiːkwənsiː əbˈʌv wˈʌns./
sentences.meaning: B2 写六句关于你的学校活动，使用每个频率高于一次的副词。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Pay attention to the sounds of the letter groups in bold.
sentences.ipa: /pˈeɪ ətˈenʃən tə ðə sˈaʊndz ɒv ðə lˈetə grˈuːps ɪn bˈəʊld./
sentences.meaning: 注意字母组以粗体表示的声音。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Put each of them in the correct place.
sentences.ipa: /pˌʊt ˈiːtʃ ɒv ðˌem ɪn ðə kərˈekt plˈeɪs./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then try to read the second one correctly.
sentences.ipa: /ðˈen trˈaɪ tə rˈiːd ðə sˈekənd wˈʌn kərˈektliː./
sentences.meaning: 那就试着正确读第二本

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Look at the following pairs of words.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː lˈʊk æt ðə fˈɒləʊɪŋ pˈeəz ɒv wˈɜːdz./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Read the first word of each pair.
sentences.ipa: /rˈiːd ðə fˈɜːst wˈɜːd ɒv ˈiːtʃ pˈeə./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C Practise saying the following phrases.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Read it with her and answer the questions below.
sentences.ipa: /rˈiːd ɪt wɪð hɜː ænd ˈɑːnsə ðə kwˈestʃənz bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 和她一起读，回答下面的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Sandy is reading the school field trip notice for the Grade 7 students.
sentences.ipa: /ə sˈændiː ɪz rˈiːdɪŋ ðə skˈuːl fˈiːld trˈɪp nˈəʊtɪs fɔː ðə grˈeɪd sˈevən stjˈuːdnts./
sentences.meaning: 一个桑迪正在读7年级学生的校外旅行通知。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Please find more on the school website.
sentences.ipa: /plˈiːz fˈaɪnd mˈɔː ˌɒn ðə skˈuːl wˈebsaɪt./
sentences.meaning: 请在学校网站上找到更多信息。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 What can the Grade 7 students do on the autumn field trip?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn wˌɒt kæn ðə grˈeɪd sˈevən stjˈuːdnts dˈuː ˌɒn ðiː ˈɔːtəm fˈiːld trˈɪp?/
sentences.meaning: 1 7年级学生秋季实地考察能做什么？。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 What do you like about your field trips?
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː wˌɒt dˈuː juː lˈaɪk əbˈaʊt jɔː fˈiːld trˈɪps?/
sentences.meaning: 2，你喜欢什么关于你的实地考察？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Listen to Mr Wu and help Sandy complete her notes.
sentences.ipa: /lˈɪsən tə mˈɪstə wuː ænd hˈelp sˈændiː kəmplˈiːt hɜː nˈəʊts./
sentences.meaning: 听吴先生的话 帮桑迪写好笔记

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Sandy is listening to Mr Wu talking about one of the field trips.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː sˈændiː ɪz lˈɪsənɪŋ tə mˈɪstə wuː tˈɔːkɪŋ əbˈaʊt wˈʌn ɒv ðə fˈiːld trˈɪps./
sentences.meaning: B Sandy在听吴先生讲一个实地考察

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: When listening for details, pay attention to some words that help us follow the content, such as in the morning, in the afternoon and then.
sentences.ipa: /wˌen lˈɪsənɪŋ fɔː dˈiːteɪlz, pˈeɪ ətˈenʃən tə sˌʌm wˈɜːdz ðæt hˈelp ˌʌs fˈɒləʊ ðə kˈɒntent, sˈʌtʃ æz ɪn ðə mˈɔːnɪŋ, ɪn ðiː ˌɑːftənˈuːn ænd ðˈen./
sentences.meaning: 在聆听细节时，注意一些帮助我们跟踪内容的文字，比如在上午，下午，然后。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Work in groups and talk about the topic.
sentences.ipa: /wˈɜːk ɪn grˈuːps ænd tˈɔːk əbˈaʊt ðə tˈɒpɪk./
sentences.meaning: 分组工作，并讨论这一专题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C Sandy and her classmates are talking about school field trips.
sentences.ipa: /sˈiː sˈændiː ænd hɜː klˈɑːsmeɪts ɑː tˈɔːkɪŋ əbˈaʊt skˈuːl fˈiːld trˈɪps./
sentences.meaning: C Sandy和她的同学正在谈论学校的实地考察。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use the conversation below as a model.
sentences.ipa: /jˈuːz ðə kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃən bɪlˈəʊ æz ə mˈɒdəl./

sentences.speaker: sandy
sentences.text: What do you like about school field trips, Amy?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɒt dˈuː juː lˈaɪk əbˈaʊt skˈuːl fˈiːld trˈɪps, ˈeɪmiː?/
sentences.meaning: 你喜欢学校野外旅行吗，艾米？

sentences.speaker: amy
sentences.text: I love field trips because I like being outside. It’s nice to get close to nature, and I can enjoy the peace and quiet there.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ lˈʌv fˈiːld trˈɪps bɪkˈɒz ˌaɪ lˈaɪk bˈiːɪŋ ˌaʊtsˈaɪd. ˌɪts nˈaɪs tə get klˈəʊs tə nˈeɪtʃə, ænd ˌaɪ kæn ɪndʒˈɔɪ ðə pˈiːs ænd kwˈaɪət ðˈeə./
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢野外旅行，因为我喜欢外出。 接近自然是件好事，我可以在那里享受和平和宁静。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: I like the teamwork on the trips. Everybody tries their best to make things better.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ lˈaɪk ðə tˈiːmwɜːk ˌɒn ðə trˈɪps. ˈevrɪbɒdiː trˈaɪz ðeə bˈest tə mˌeɪk θˈɪŋz bˈetə./
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢旅行中的团队合作每个人都尽力让事情变得更好

sentences.speaker: sandy
sentences.text: Yes, but sometimes field trips are too tiring for me. I like our class duties on Mondays. It feels good to keep our school area clean.
sentences.ipa: /jˈes, bˌʌt sˈʌmtaɪmz fˈiːld trˈɪps ɑː tˈuː tˈaɪərɪŋ fɔː mˌiː. ˌaɪ lˈaɪk ˌaʊə klˈɑːs djˈuːtiːz ˌɒn mˈʌndeɪz. ˌɪt fˈiːlz gˈʊd tə kˈiːp ˌaʊə skˈuːl ˈeərɪə klˈiːn./
sentences.meaning: 是的，但有时实地考察对我来说太累了，我喜欢我们周一的课课，让我们的校区保持清洁感觉很好。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D Sunshine Middle School newsletter is inviting students to send in articles about their hands-on learning at school.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː sˈʌnʃaɪn mˈɪdəl skˈuːl njˈuːzlˌetə ɪz ɪnvˈaɪtɪŋ stjˈuːdnts tə sˈend ˈɪn ˈɑːtɪkəlz əbˈaʊt ðeə hˌændzˈɒn lˈɜːnɪŋ æt skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: D阳光中学通讯邀请学生发文章介绍自己在学校的亲身学习。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D1 Answer the questions below with the information about your school.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː wˈʌn ˈɑːnsə ðə kwˈestʃənz bɪlˈəʊ wɪð ðiː ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən əbˈaʊt jɔː skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: D1 以有关你学校的资料来回答下面的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 How often does it take place?
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː hˌaʊ ˈɒfən dˈʌz ɪt tˈeɪk plˈeɪs?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 How many students take part in it?
sentences.ipa: /fˈɔː hˌaʊ mˈeniː stjˈuːdnts tˈeɪk pˈɑːt ɪn ɪt?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: 5，你通常做什么？ 5，你平时做什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 6 What can you learn from it?
sentences.ipa: /sˈɪks wˌɒt kæn juː lˈɜːn frɒm ɪt?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D2 Read Sandy’s article about her hands-on learning at school.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː tˈuː rˈiːd sˈændiːz ˈɑːtɪkəl əbˈaʊt hɜː hˌændzˈɒn lˈɜːnɪŋ æt skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: D2 Read Sandy的文章讲述了她在学校的亲身学习。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: and I clean the blackboard and empty the bins.
sentences.ipa: /ænd ˌaɪ klˈiːn ðə blˈækbɔːd ænd ˈemptiː ðə bˈɪnz./
sentences.meaning: 我清理黑板 清空垃圾箱

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D3 Write an article about hands-on learning at your school based on the information in Part D1.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː θrˈiː rˈaɪt ən ˈɑːtɪkəl əbˈaʊt hˌændzˈɒn lˈɜːnɪŋ æt jɔː skˈuːl bˈeɪst ˌɒn ðiː ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən ɪn pˈɑːt dˈiː wˈʌn./
sentences.meaning: D3根据D1部分中的信息，写一篇关于你学校的实践学习的文章。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use Sandy’s article as a model.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: 我最喜欢的舞蹈/活动是..。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: 这份工作/工作/活动有助于我..。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢这种舞蹈/活动，因为..。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 I can describe school life at Sunshine Middle School.
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn ˌaɪ kæn dɪskrˈaɪb skˈuːl lˈaɪf æt sˈʌnʃaɪn mˈɪdəl skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 1，我可以描述阳光中学的学校生活。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 I can use prepositions of time and adverbs of frequency correctly.
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː ˌaɪ kæn jˈuːz prˌepəzˈɪʃənz ɒv tˈaɪm ænd ˈædvɜːbz ɒv frˈiːkwənsiː kərˈektliː./
sentences.meaning: 2，我可以正确使用时间的预位和频率的副词。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 I can talk and write about my school days with the new words in this unit.
sentences.ipa: /θrˈiː ˌaɪ kæn tˈɔːk ænd rˈaɪt əbˈaʊt maɪ skˈuːl dˈeɪz wɪð ðə njˈuː wˈɜːdz ɪn ðɪs jˈuːnɪt./
sentences.meaning: 3，我可以用这个单位的新词来谈论和写我的上学的日子。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.ipa: /dˈʌbəljuː, ˈef ænd ˈɑː kərˈektliː ɪn wˈɜːdz./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 I know how to enjoy school life.
sentences.ipa: /fˈaɪv ˌaɪ nˈəʊ hˌaʊ tʊ ɪndʒˈɔɪ skˈuːl lˈaɪf./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: * Assess your learning of new words and grammar by doing the exercises on page 115.
sentences.ipa: /əsˈes jɔː lˈɜːnɪŋ ɒv njˈuː wˈɜːdz ænd grˈæmə baɪ dˈuːɪŋ ðiː ˈeksəsaɪzɪz ˌɒn pˈeɪdʒ wˈʌn hˈʌndrəd fˌɪftˈiːn./
sentences.meaning: *通过第115页的练习来评估你对新词和语法的学习。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I need to spend more time on.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ nˈiːd tə spˈend mˈɔː tˈaɪm ˌɒn./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: one book, one pen, one child and one teacher can change the world. Teachers open the door, but you must enter by yourself. Tell me and I forget, teach me and I may remember, involve me and I learn. The beautiful thing about learning is that no one can take it away from you.
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn bˈʊk, wˈʌn pˈen, wˈʌn tʃˈaɪld ænd wˈʌn tˈiːtʃə kæn tʃˈeɪndʒ ðə wˈɜːld. tˈiːtʃəz ˈəʊpən ðə dˈɔː, bˌʌt juː mˈʌst ˈentə baɪ jɔːsˈelf. tˈel mˌiː ænd ˌaɪ fəgˈet, tˈiːtʃ mˌiː ænd ˌaɪ mˈeɪ rɪmˈembə, ɪnvˈɒlv mˌiː ænd ˌaɪ lˈɜːn. ðə bjˈuːtɪfʊl θˈɪŋ əbˈaʊt lˈɜːnɪŋ ɪz ðæt nˈəʊ wˈʌn kæn tˈeɪk ɪt əwˈeɪ frɒm juː./
sentences.meaning: 一个书，一个笔，一个孩子和一个老师可以改变世界。老师打开大门，但你必须自己进入。告诉我和我忘记，教我，我可能记得，让我和我在学习中参与其中。学习的美丽之处在于没有人能从你身上夺走它。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: There are many famous quotes and sayings about learning.
sentences.ipa: /ðˌeə ɑː mˈeniː fˈeɪməs kwˈəʊts ænd sˈeɪɪŋz əbˈaʊt lˈɜːnɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 关于学习，有许多著名的引言和说法。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Find more and discuss them with your classmates.
sentences.ipa: /fˈaɪnd mˈɔː ænd dɪskˈʌs ðˌem wɪð jɔː klˈɑːsmeɪts./
sentences.meaning: 找更多的东西和同学们讨论一下
